name: capability-provider
description: The provider-neutral capability-provider interface (W056, the W035–W041 flat source-exported pattern). Spec: REQUIREMENTS.md R055 — 'Arena is optional': external capability providers are a PLUGGABLE class, and this package defines the PROVIDER-NEUTRAL interface through which they plug into the empirical chain — ZERO concrete-provider specifics (the concrete adapters are later lanes' packages, built ON this interface). A ProviderRegistration is typed DATA: an opaque canonical provider id content-addressed over the display identity + scope + lineage + the offers (each offer typed VERBATIM through the W040 descriptor vocabulary — kind/domain/bearer — with MeasuredEvidence citations the W040 gate re-proves, optional W041 skill endowment citations, and per-offer lifecycle carried from W040). registerProvider is THE GATE: every offer's evidence is re-proved THE WAY W040 proves its own (W040's registerCapability carried verbatim — experimentIdOf binding, findings digest re-derivation, verdict law), scope agreement, duplicate provider/offer ids, fail-closed closed-set checks; R052 enforced STRUCTURALLY — an unmeasured offer is the typed loud 'unmeasured-offer' error naming the law. CapabilityProviderPort is the minimal neutral surface a CONCRETE provider implements (listOffers / describeOffer / the provenance accessor), satisfied here only by a deterministic in-memory reference adapter. matchProviderOffers(demand, registration, registry) adjudicates deterministically: W040's matchCapabilityDemand carried VERBATIM against each offer in canonical offer-id order (the tiebreak law), with a content-addressed adjudication id. validateProviderRegistration re-proves the whole registration from its recorded data. A9 throughout: same registration + same registry ⇒ deep-equal adjudication, same canonical ids. A14: the interface COMPOSES and ADJUDICATES typed data — it never executes a provider. NO entitlements, no marketplace semantics, no execution, no I/O.
